title: Lamborghini Revuelto or Ferrari 12Cilindri? The Real Difference
description:
Two Italian supercars. Two six point five liter V12 engines. Both revealed within about a year of each other, both with eight-speed dual-clutch gearboxes, and both priced like a house. On paper, the Lamborghini Revuelto and the Ferrari twelve Cilindri look like twins. In reality, they are built on opposite answers to the same question. The question is simple. How do you keep a V12 alive in a world of emissions rules and electric cars? Lamborghini added three electric motors and a battery. Ferrari added nothing electric at all. And that single decision changes everything about how these two cars look, drive, and cost.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
